crime.value: Premeditated murder disguised as a car accident: wife stages a crash, slashes husband's wrist with a razor blade, having forged his driver's license blood type so the emergency transfusion of incompatible blood kills him. Question: was the fatal wound accidental, and what actually killed him?
crime.quote: "It was the transfusion that killed him," Bill said. "It was the transfusion that was meant to kill him, Mrs. Brown."

victim.value: Pythias Brown, a cracker construction worker of modest means, married to Delilah; killable because his existence blocked her from marrying his rich best friend Damon Lang
victim.quote: The basic solution to her immediate dream-compulsion was, naturally, for Pythias to be evaporated into outer space

closed_world.value: Halcyon, Florida — a rain-lashed lonely stretch of road and Dr. Hillegas Dow's isolated small clinic on a storm-flooded Monday night, with only a handful of participants
closed_world.quote: It was a lonesome span of road, made melancholy on one side by scrub palmettos and on the other by a hyacinth-choked canal.

culprit_and_motive.value: Delilah Brown, the wife, who wanted widowhood so she could marry wealthy Damon Lang before his December wedding to Ethel Chalice
culprit_and_motive.quote: If (she would turgidly think) I were married to Damon instead of to Pythias, I would have that kidney-bean-shaped swimming pool

resolution.value: B.C.I. man Bill exposes her: razor-blade cardboard guard in her purse, wound location inconsistent with windshield glass, Dr. Dow's blood test showing type O, and microscope/handwriting evidence of the altered license
resolution.quote: after you had changed the original O into an A by drawing a line down on either side of it... Showed up plain under Dr. Dow's microscope

investigator.value: Bill, a Bureau of Criminal Identification officer with institutional authority, assisted by sheriff's deputy Chuck; narration is omniscient, largely from the culprit's viewpoint
investigator.quote: Bill carried his six foot two inches of whipcord intelligence and superlative B.C.I, training over to the trio.

suspect_architecture.value: Inverted mystery: culprit known from the start. The nominal 'suspect' field is filled by intended fall guys/parties — Delilah (the murderer-wife, motive: marry rich Damon), Damon Lang (unwitting blood donor made instrument), and Dr. Hillegas Dow (the 'goat', a venal naturopath chosen to bungle treatment). Investigators are Chuck (sheriff's deputy) and Bill (B.C.I. man).
suspect_architecture.quote: All she needed was a goat. Delilah pin-pointed this goat in the bulging, perspiration-moistened person of a Dr. Hillegas Dow.

red_herring.value: The staged car crash and windshield glass, meant to explain the wrist artery wound as accidental; plus Delilah's screaming demand for help and a transfusion to prove wifely concern.
red_herring.quote: "It was the windshield glass that made my dear, dead husband bleed."

clue_fairness.value: Fair: reader watches Delilah search Pythias' slacks pockets, prepare the razor blade, and 'lift' information from Damon before the reveal; the Florida licence blood-type box and Damon's Type A card are shown in scene.
clue_fairness.quote: Delilah explored the pockets of his slacks and then arranged the first ingredient of her recipe

social_world.value: Florida boom-town Halcyon: 'crackers' versus snowbird Westchester money; Lang family turpentine/citrus/real-estate wealth against Pythias' Sears installment rating; unlicensed clinic doctor dependent on cash patients; sheriff's deputy on cosy first-name terms with the nurse.
social_world.quote: The Langs had prospered abundantly through several generations of turpentine stands, citrus groves, and eventually valuable real estate

alibi.value: No alibi sought — Delilah is openly present as driver; her defence is instead the innocent-skid story and her loud efforts to save him.
alibi.quote: "It was all because I didn't control the skid."

reveal_mechanic.value: Forensic demonstration: Dr. Dow's blood test proves Pythias was type O, death by cardiac/cerebral embolism from clumping AB blood; and the altered driver's licence — O redrawn into A, with B added in Delilah's hand — shows plain under the microscope, plus the razor-blade cardboard guard in her bag.
reveal_mechanic.quote: "after you had changed the original O into an A by drawing a line down on either side of it"

media_and_audience.value: Delilah packages herself for an audience — screaming performance at the crash, 'Academy performance' of widowed grief, radio weather bulletins used as staging cues; Bill's closing line frames it as a sensational novelty crime.
media_and_audience.quote: "Weirdest murder weapon I ever came across in my life."

victims_enemies.value: Pythias Brown's only true enemy is his own wife Delilah, who resents his modest income (Sears installments, Texaco card) and covets his rich best friend Damon Lang; everyone else — Damon especially — is devoted to him.
victims_enemies.quote: If (she would turgidly think) I were married to Damon instead of to Pythias, I would have that kidney-bean-shaped swimming pool

suspect_wounds.value: Dr. Hillegas Dow is the intended 'goat': a naturopath/chiropodist barred from hospitals, greedy and ethically flaccid, who refuses to call an ambulance so he can bill the patient — making a fatal transfusion look like his malpractice. Damon's wound is his selfless devotion, which makes him literally the hand that kills his friend.
suspect_wounds.quote: All she needed was a goat. Delilah pin-pointed this goat in the bulging, perspiration-moistened person of a Dr. Hillegas Dow.

unreliable_frame.value: Delilah's account — the skid, the hysteria, the wifely grief — is a sustained performance narrated ironically by an omniscient voice that lets us see her calculation beneath every sob; her 'Sarah Bernhart interpretation' is the lie the officials must penetrate.
unreliable_frame.quote: Beneath her Academy performance of just-widowed grief, she was one utterly satisfied and contented cat.

setting_as_constraint.value: Florida's storm season and a lonesome stretch of blacktop between palmetto scrub and a hyacinth canal: Delilah waits days for the weather reports to promise heavy rain so a skid is credible, and stages the crash at a Gru-gru palm beside the one isolated clinic she has pre-scouted, guaranteeing no ambulance and no hospital blood typing.
setting_as_constraint.quote: She had scouted the route several times before tonight, and knew exactly the location of a tall Gru-gru palm tree

evidence_type.value: Documentary/forensic hybrid: the altered blood-type box on Pythias's Florida driver's license (O redrawn into A, plus an added B), proven by microscope and handwriting comparison, corroborated by the razor-blade cardboard guard in her handbag and Dr. Dow's post-mortem blood typing.
evidence_type.quote: after you had changed the original O into an A by drawing a line down on either side of it and straightening its curved bottom

false_suspect.value: Dr. Hillegas Dow, the mercenary unlicensed-for-hospitals practitioner who administers the fatal transfusion and blocks the ambulance — designed to absorb blame as a quack who botched a case.
false_suspect.quote: "Shall I phone for an ambulance?" Mabel Oestringer suggested... "Certainly not!"

technical_detail.value: Incompatible-blood-transfusion mortality: type AB donor blood into a type O recipient causes corpuscles to clump, producing cardiac and cerebral embolism — cyanosis, rapid pulse, labored breathing, death; exploited via the state-issued self-printed blood type on a driver's license and an artery slashed with a single-edged razor blade to force an emergency transfusion.
technical_detail.quote: Mr. Brown died from cardiac and cerebral embolism due to your blood corpuscles collecting into clumps.

moral_ambiguity.value: Minimal — Delilah is coolly acquisitive rather than sympathetic; the nearest ambiguity is Dr. Dow, whose venality is framed as ordinary human weakness ('neither a complete dud nor a quack'), and Damon, guiltless yet the literal instrument of his friend's death.
moral_ambiguity.quote: in all truth the doctor was neither a complete dud nor a quack.

_meta.title: Damon and Pythias and Delilah Brown
_meta.author: RUFUS KING
